issue:
simpify gives `Imaginary coordinates are not permitted.` with evaluate(False)
## Issue
`with evaluate(False)` crashes unexpectedly with `Point2D`

## Code
```python
import sympy as sp
with sp.evaluate(False):
  sp.S('Point2D(Integer(1),Integer(2))')
```


However, it works without `with evaluate(False)`. Both of following commands work
```python
sp.S('Point2D(Integer(1),Integer(2))')
sp.S('Point2D(Integer(1),Integer(2))', evaluate=False)
```

import pytest

def test_evaluate_false_context_manager_with_point2d():
    import sympy as sp
    from sympy.geometry.point import Point2D

    # Case 1: default evaluate (True)
    expr1 = sp.S('Point2D(Integer(1),Integer(2))')
    assert isinstance(expr1, Point2D)
    assert expr1.x == 1
    assert expr1.y == 2

    # Case 2: explicit evaluate=False
    expr2 = sp.S('Point2D(Integer(1),Integer(2))', evaluate=False)
    assert isinstance(expr2, Point2D)
    assert expr2.x == 1
    assert expr2.y == 2

    # Case 3: context manager evaluate=False
    with sp.evaluate(False):
        expr3 = sp.S('Point2D(Integer(1),Integer(2))')
    assert isinstance(expr3, Point2D)
    assert expr3.x == 1
    assert expr3.y == 2
